For questions about student registration, qualifications, and employment documents, I first recommend reading the FAQ on the university Careers Centre website: <https://careers.xjtlu.edu.cn/Dispatch/Home/Master>

## Student registration and CHSI {#学籍学信网}

While we are studying, our student registration cannot be found on CHSI (学信网). It can, however, be checked on the Ministry of Education's website for Chinese-foreign cooperation in running schools: <http://rzzccx.crs.jsj.edu.cn/>. So forget about offers such as Haidilao's university student discount that require CHSI verification: we are not eligible. You may be able to get an Apple Store student discount. The policy changes each year, so I suggest calling the physical Apple Store directly to ask.

After graduation, your Liverpool degree needs Ministry of Education credential recognition to be recognized by the Ministry. See [Thesis, viva, and graduation](thesis-and-graduation.qmd#sec.thesis_viva_graduation).

## Transcripts {#成绩单}

Unlike domestic Chinese PhD programmes, we do not receive a transcript when we graduate. Liverpool's equivalent of a transcript is the HEAR report, but a student who asked Liverpool directly was explicitly told that PhD students do not receive one. If an employer insists on a transcript, email Liverpool to ask.

(12 August 2024, by [Kai Wu](mailto:kaiwu.astro@gmail.com))
